text_block_list.text:
—Right now, I am facing a harsh reality.
I hadn't checked for a while, but—
To think it had gotten this bad...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Um!
Is something troubling you, desu ne?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You had such a serious look on your face.
If it's okay with you, would you tell me about it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Without realizing it, your weight has—

Even as a Trainer, when you're working hard alongside
your trainee horse girl in training every day,
you naturally work up quite an appetite...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Holding back on the things you want to eat
is really, really tough, isn't it, desu ne...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...If you like, would you let me help you?
I have some ideas for menus
suited for cutting weight.
choice_data_list: No, you don't have to go that far—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But I can't just leave you like this...! 
Please, let me lend a hand, desu!

...And so, feeling rather apologetic,
I ended up having her support my personal diet, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
!
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's go for a jog right away!
...Ah! Of course, we'll keep it at a light pace!

She went out of her way to accompany me
on morning jogs—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san.
I made a bento for you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's low in calories, but high in dietary fiber
so you won't get hungry as easily.
Make sure to chew thoroughly, desu ne!
...She cared for me with the utmost kindness.

However, on the other hand, a dark,
vulgar, uncontrollable urge was
welling up inside me.
choice_data_list: I-I want to eat... something terribly unhealthy...!

text_block_list.text:
If I just went down to the cafeteria in sight below,
I could unleash this desire to my heart's content.
But... still...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you have
lunch with me today?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Today's main dish is simmered freeze-dried tofu.
I made sure the flavors soaked in re~ally well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's chew thoroughly together!
One, two, three, four...—

—It's delicious as always. But...
this feeling of being an ascetic monk with my food is unavoidable—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
............Ahaha.
Dieting really is tough, isn't it, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
When you're hungry, after all, you want to eat
your favorite food most of all.
And yet... you have to endure it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even if your stomach isn't completely full—at the very least...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if we savored and ate it together like this—
your heart might feel full instead.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I hope it helped.

And then—thanks to Buena Vista's dedicated support,
I safely managed to reach my target weight.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness...! 
You really worked so hard, Trainer-san...!

Reaching my goal safely was unmistakably
thanks to Buena Vista.
I couldn't thank her enou—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Giggle. Looks like Trainer-san's
stomach felt relieved too,
and let its guard down, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I can make meals for you anytime.
Even if they might be a bit low on calories... fufu.

It was a moment that made me experience
Buena Vista's boundless kindness firsthand—

...However, deep down in my heart,
that dark desire began to rear its head once more.
choice_data_list: (If it's just a little bit... overeating won't—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Do you want to eat a lot, desu ka?
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's alright. Even if you end up gaining weight again,
I'll be there to help you out once more.

It was a moment that made me experience
Buena Vista's boundless kindness firsthand—
